food_beverage.name: Exemption Pre-check
food_beverage.requirement: Not exempt if qty <10g/10ml (non-tobacco), not hotel/restaurant fast food, not farm produce >50kg

food_beverage.name: Generic/Common Name
food_beverage.requirement: Clear identifiable product name, distinct from brand

food_beverage.name: Standard Quantity Compliance
food_beverage.requirement: If SKU is edible oil/vanaspati/baby food/tea/coffee/salt/etc., must match prescribed pack sizes

food_beverage.name: MRP
food_beverage.requirement: Rs./₹ symbol + 'inclusive of all taxes' phrase present

food_beverage.name: Unit Sale Price Reconciliation
food_beverage.requirement: MRP ÷ net qty must mathematically reconcile

food_beverage.name: Date of Mfg/Pack/Import
food_beverage.requirement: Valid format (MM/YYYY, DD-MM-YYYY, or MFD prefix)

food_beverage.name: Best Before / Use By
food_beverage.requirement: Required where shelf-life is time-sensitive; Best Before alone is NOT a substitute for Expiry/Use By

food_beverage.name: Consumer Care Details
food_beverage.requirement: Phone (10-digit) + email + postal address, all 3 present

food_beverage.name: Font-Height-to-Area Ratio
food_beverage.requirement: Per area-based slab; requires calibrated pixel-to-mm measurement

food_beverage.name: E-commerce Listing Match
food_beverage.requirement: All fields except mfg date replicated on digital listing

food_beverage.name: FSSAI License No.
food_beverage.requirement: 14-digit presence + syntax check (Tier 1); live FoSCoS verify (Tier 2/3)

food_beverage.name: Multi-piece/Combo Declaration
food_beverage.requirement: If sold as combo/multi-unit, main package carries full declaration

apparel_textile.name: Loose vs Pre-packed Pre-check
apparel_textile.requirement: If sold loose/open (not sealed) → fully exempt, stop pipeline here

apparel_textile.name: Fiber Composition
apparel_textile.requirement: Percentages must sum to exactly 100% (99%/101% flagged as math violation)

apparel_textile.name: Size in Metric
apparel_textile.requirement: cm/inches mandatory; S/M/L is additional only, not a substitute

apparel_textile.name: Generic/Common Name
apparel_textile.requirement: e.g. 'Men's T-Shirt', 'Saree' — matched against apparel taxonomy dictionary

apparel_textile.name: Unit Sale Price
apparel_textile.requirement: If multi-piece pack, per-piece price reconciliation

apparel_textile.name: E-commerce Listing Match
apparel_textile.requirement: Digital listing mirrors physical label (except mfg date)

apparel_textile.name: Font-Height-to-Area Ratio
apparel_textile.requirement: STATUS: verify exact applicability clause for apparel before hardcoding as full bypass — flagged gap

general_retail.name: Generic/Common Name
general_retail.requirement: Clear product identity, distinct from brand

general_retail.name: Net Quantity
general_retail.requirement: Standard unit, or 'number' for countable goods

general_retail.name: Standard Quantity Compliance
general_retail.requirement: If SKU falls under Second Schedule list (rare in this bucket, e.g. cement in bags)

general_retail: default/catch-all when no strong signal for above two
